analysis.title: GS Bartlett - GS TMT TODAY 10.14.26
key_insights: Futures were mixed early (Nasdaq -15bps, SPX +20bps, Russell +25bps). Semis and AI lagged the broader market again, with semis on a 5-day losing streak, the worst since July.
WTI crude was up 1.25% at $95.30 on Middle East tensions. Reports say Houthis struck Saudi Aramco HQ and Iran continues to strike tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

ASML reported 3Q26 revenue in line with Visible Alpha consensus and EBIT 5% above consensus. Gross margin was about 57% against VA consensus of 56%, helped by installed base and upgrade revenue. The ADR was down about 50-60bps pre-market despite the beat and raise, another sell-the-news reaction.
ASML raised 2026 guidance to revenue of EUR44-45bn (prior EUR43-45bn) and gross margin of about 56% (prior 54-56%). The midpoint implies revenue 1% above consensus.
ASML expects EUV revenue growth of 45% y/y in 2026, non-EUV growth of about 20% and installed base management growth of about 50%. It reiterated shipping 65 EUV units in 2026.

ASML said its planned 30% EUV capacity increase in each of 2027 and 2028 is not enough to meet customer demand. It is exploring ways to add more than 30% in 2028 and beyond. Bears point to the lack of 2027 capacity upgrades, while bulls point to the margin beat, a guide to higher units in 2028 and demand pulled up for 2029-30.

CRWV fell 4% as social media focused on spiking bond yields. Chamath warned of a 'private credit bubble' and Elon retweeted 'Yikes'. Separately, the FT reports CoreWeave is seeking insurers' capital to fund its AI build-out and wants investment-grade ratings on more of its chip-backed debt.
HPE, NTAP and DELL were lower after Barclays downgraded each to Equal weight. MU and SNDK were lower in 8 of the last 9 sessions.
GOOGL rose about 1% on the Gemini 4 Argon release.

ACN rose 4% after slides ahead of its Investor Day targeted mid-single-digit local-currency revenue growth for FY27 and FY28, mid-to-high-single-digit growth for FY29, and 10-30bps of annual operating margin expansion. INFY rose 2% in sympathy.
The Information reports OpenAI is in early talks to buy Trail of Bits to build its cybersecurity business. The deal could fall apart.

GTA VI launches Nov. 19. Some analysts expect 40 million copies sold on PlayStation and Xbox and more than $3 billion of revenue in the first four months. Other entertainment companies have delayed releases to avoid the launch window.

GS Internet research (Sheridan) describes the US digital ad Q3'26 backdrop as resilient end demand, strong momentum exiting the quarter among larger players, and an accelerating shift toward lower-funnel performance channels driven by AI.

US core CPI is due this morning. GIR expects +0.24% m/m core against +0.2% consensus. UST yields were little changed (2yr 4.775%, 10yr 5.2%, 30yr 5.55%). China trade data was strong, PPI hot and CPI cooler.
Fed speakers are in focus after Williams' dovish remarks yesterday: Bowman (voter, 5:40am), Barkin (non-voter, 1:30pm), Goolsbee (non-voter, 3pm) and Bowman again (voter, 10:55pm).

GS is incrementally positive on AMAT after its SEMICON West investor breakfast. The stock fell 7% in a sector-wide selloff, possibly on the lack of a medium-term WFE forecast and earnings target before 2030. GS expects the stock to recover as earnings power rises by 2028 on outsized WFE growth and exposure to deposition and etch.
GS hosted a meeting with PENG (Buy) management, which reinforced its position in enterprise and neocloud on-premise AI infrastructure and its margin-accretive memory module business.

earnings_insights: ASML 3Q26 (reported 10/14): revenue in line with Visible Alpha consensus, EBIT 5% above consensus, gross margin about 57% vs VA consensus 56%.
ASML FY26 guidance (company guide, raised 10/14): revenue EUR44-45bn (prior EUR43-45bn), gross margin about 56% (prior 54-56%). The midpoint implies revenue 1% above consensus.
ASML 4Q26 guidance is above consensus per GIR first take.

ACN FY27 and FY28 targets (company targets from Investor Day slides, 10/14): mid-single-digit local-currency revenue growth. The company previously guided 3-6% revenue growth for FY27 in its October earnings release.
ACN targets mid-to-high-single-digit FY29 local-currency revenue growth and 10-30bps operating margin expansion in FY27, FY28 and FY29.
Pre-market earnings 10/14: PGR, BLK, BAC, FAST, MS, STT, ASML. Upcoming: ERIC and TSM pre-market 10/15, AXP pre-market 10/16.
GS expects Q3'26 US digital ad earnings to show resilient demand and strong exit momentum (GS Internet preview).
